capability: Each gate checks a different kind of thing
title: Every miss gets a new gate.

hook.picture: Close on the whale stamping ticks on a smooth line and sending it to a pod, which answers ✕ in raw sienna.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It passed every check. Then a customer found the bug.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: product owner, reading a support ticket

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Runs flow past the whale, checked by eye. Three times, faster each time, a different kind of mistake slips past and a pod answers ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Eyes get tired. Runs keep coming.

stakes.body: A customer finds the bug first, so trust is lost and the fix costs more than the check would have.

solution_hint: Let a machine check every run.

metaphor.body: Each gate checks one kind of thing, shown as an icon on its lintel. A miss of a new kind passes them all, and its flag becomes the icon of a new gate.

steps.picture: Three gates rise on the line, each with one icon on its lintel: a wobble, a colour lens, a gap. All openings are the same size.
A wobbly run hits the wobble gate. The bar drops across the opening and it stops.
steps.words: Each gate checks one kind of thing.
steps.sound: Bell, then a soft stop knock

steps.picture: Push-in: a smooth raw-sienna run glides through the wobble gate (it glows, fairly) and stops at the colour-lens gate.
steps.sound: Bell glows, then the lens bell stops it

steps.picture: A run with a gap passes the wobble and colour gates and stops at the gap gate.
steps.words: A different kind of mistake, a different gate.

steps.picture: A good slate run threads all three. Each opening glows in turn and a tick lands beside each gate.
steps.sound: Three bells in a row, resolved

steps.picture: The whale rests on the line while runs keep flowing and stopping by themselves.

real_case.claim: Manu's escapes register lists 7 defects that passed the studio's gates. Each is now caught by a different kind of check (a font checked by its declared name is now checked by the face that renders).

honest_limit.picture: A run flowing backwards, a kind no gate checks, glows through all three gates and reaches the pod, which answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: A new kind of miss passes every gate.

not_this.body: Passing means no known failures. Not quality.

ending_pattern.body: The flag from the miss becomes the icon of a fourth gate. The backwards run stops there and is turned round, and the same pod now answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing and the same pod as bar 2: its ✕ becomes ✓.

end_belief.body: Machines check every run. Misses become new checks.

beats.picture: Close on the whale stamping three small ticks onto a smooth raw-sienna line, then nudging it toward a waiting pod.
beats.sound: Three soft stamps, a hopeful rising note

beats.picture: The pod tastes the line and answers ✕ in raw sienna. The line was meant to be slate.
beats.sound: The glass bell, muffled to a dull thunk

beats.picture: The pod turns away. The three ticks on the line look small and useless now.
beats.words: Then a customer found the bug.

beats.picture: The whale stares at the ✕. Hold, breathing only.
Hinge: half a bar of stillness, then the title card.
Pull back: a stream of runs flows past the whale, which checks each one by eye, squinting.
The whale's eyelids droop. Runs keep coming.
beats.words: Eyes get tired. Runs keep coming.

beats.picture: Three times, faster (2 beats, 1, ½): a wobbly run, a wrong-colour run and a run with a gap slip past. Each pod downstream answers ✕.
Everything stops. Three empty gate outlines ghost onto the line.
beats.words: Let a machine check every run.
beats.sound: First clean glass bell: the signature

beats.picture: Three gates rise on the line, each with one icon on its lintel: a wobble, a colour lens, a gap. All openings are the same size.
A wobbly run hits the wobble gate. The bar drops across the opening and it stops.
beats.words: Each gate checks one kind of thing.
beats.sound: Bell, then a soft stop knock

beats.sound: Bell glows, then the lens bell stops it
beats.camera: one push-in to z 1.3 on the decisive moment

beats.picture: A run with a gap passes the wobble and colour gates and stops at the gap gate.
beats.words: A different kind of mistake, a different gate.

beats.picture: A good slate run threads all three. Each opening glows in turn and a tick lands beside each gate.
beats.sound: Three bells in a row, resolved

beats.picture: The whale rests on the line while runs keep flowing and stopping by themselves.
Wide: the line stretches out. Seven gates stand in a row, each with its own icon and a small folded flag tied to it.
The card fades in on clean paper beside the row.
beats.words: Real misses from our own studio.

beats.picture: Slow drift past one gate: its icon shows a label and a typeface that don't match.
beats.words: Each miss taught a new kind of check.

beats.picture: A run arrives flowing backwards (its arrowheads point the wrong way). The wobble, colour and gap gates all glow. It passes them all.
beats.words: A new kind of miss passes every gate.
beats.camera: still, then one slow push to what slipped

beats.picture: Slow push to the pod: it answers ✕ and a raw-sienna flag drops on the line.
beats.camera: still, then one slow push to what slipped

beats.picture: Still on the flag.
beats.words: Passing means no known failures. Not quality.
beats.camera: still, then one slow push to what slipped

beats.picture: FELT framing restored (z 1.6, the same pod). The flag drifts up and settles on an empty lintel as a new arrow icon: a fourth gate.
beats.sound: A new glass ping, a new timbre

beats.picture: The backwards run arrives and stops at the arrow gate. The whale turns it round.
It threads all four gates. The pod that said ✕ in bar 2 answers ✓. Spark.
Still row of four gates. A quiet run threads them while the whale breathes.
beats.words: Machines check every run. Misses become new checks.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the still line.
beats.sound: Pad tail ends in room tone

sound.signature: A struck glass bell per gate, one pitch per kind of check
sound.problem_motif: The same bell muffled to a dull thunk

score_self.reason: Problem lands on a pod by 3 s. Kinds differ visibly (wobble, colour, gap, direction). Case is Manu's own register. Risk: seven icons in CASE may crowd a phone screen.
